answer: Sybil resistance holds when each agent locks a scarce on-ledger bond before its vote weighs anything. A quiet whisper of reputation only crosses an island of bonded peers: newcomers post a marble-sized stake that burns on proven multi-key clones. Countersigners check the bond is live and unique per key; unbonded flood identities earn zero attestation weight, so spam cannot outvote honest bonded agents.
